title: WLD5050
tagline: Human-Verified 50/50 Raffles On World Coin. Verified by World ID. Powered by Chainlink. ENS badges.
description: Create a 50/50 raffle or buy tickets. World ID guarantees verified human raffles. Chainlink CRE selects the winner and pays out automatically (demo ran local simulation) no claiming, no waiting. 1 Raffle. 1 Ticket. 1 World ID. ENS integration allows winners to create badges (ENS subdomains). Privy wallet connect (easier onboarding).
how_its_made: I basically started with just front end (Nextjs ) then started designing front end ( barebones) made it look better, added the branding. I wanted to learn new networks and deploy a new bit5050 dApp utilizing (World Coin, Chainlink, ENS, & Privy). Solidity smart contract was deployed on WLD, Chainlink handles the settelement (winner selection/prize distribution) ENS ( no hexa wallet display/badge minting for raffle winners via subdomains) and Privy (clean easy onboarding/wallet connect).
auto_summary: A Next.js raffle app and Solidity contracts for World Chain that verify users with World ID, automate raffle settlement, and issue ENS winner subnames.
